== Photo identification ==

[[:File:Brad DeFruiter.jpg]] is the profile photo of a public social-media account named "Brad DeFruiter" ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261027202550/https://bsky.app/profile/plainbrad.bsky.social preserved copy, 27 October 2026]). Under the Small World Rule we take it to be him: DeFruiter is a rare surname, and the account is followed by former Decipher designer [[Chuck Kallenbach]], who worked on Star Trek CCG alongside him ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261027203059/https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.graph.getFollowers?actor=plainbrad.bsky.social&limit=100 follower list, preserved copy]). The profile itself does not mention Decipher or Star Trek CCG. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 20:32, 27 October 2026 (UTC)
